caption:
is glass skin right for my skin type?

A new study presented at the EADV Congress 2026 looked at 38 viral Korean skincare and glass-skin videos. 84% didn't account for skin type, and none were made by dermatologists. (Congress data, not yet a peer-reviewed paper.)

Oily or breakout-prone: fewer, lighter layers.
Dry or tight: layering hydration can help.
Sensitive: one active at a time.

Match the routine to your skin, not to the video.

General education only.
